comments.text: I use AI in my work every day. I come from a marketing background and also do some creative work. Nowadays, with the new AI tools coming out, such as Anthropic's Fable 5.1 and GPT-6, there's a lot to explore. No doubt, these are very good, but when I see their price, I think more about whether it will be worth using them rather than being excited. Still, something like the Deep Seek Flash or glm 5.3 flash I am still using these because their output is good. I compared them with Fable 5 and GPT-6, but they are workable. Plus, their price is quite affordable. I often think about whether these new tools will provide real-life benefits unless there is a heavily funded project or a highly budget project involved.
